request.style: English, heartland country, steady baritone male vocal, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, harmonica, brushed drums, resolute and encouraging, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Old Moses stood by the Jordan, a hundred and twenty years
He could not cross the river, but he did not speak with fear
The LORD your God himself will cross over ahead of you
And Joshua will lead you, as the LORD has said he'd do

[Chorus]
Be strong and courageous
Do not be afraid, do not be terrified
For the LORD your God goes with you
He will never fail you or forsake you

[Verse]
Then he called young Joshua in the sight of all the land
Said the road ahead is yours now, and the people in your hand
You will bring them to the country that the LORD swore long ago
To the fathers as their inheritance, so take it, and go

[Chorus]
Be strong and courageous
Do not be afraid, do not be terrified
For the LORD your God goes with you
He will never fail you or forsake you

[Bridge]
The LORD himself goes before you; he will be with you
He will never fail you or forsake you
Do not be afraid; do not be dismayed

[Outro]
Be strong and courageous
He will never fail you or forsake you
